description: Intent i017 (SNAPSHOT=s01, BRANCH=kind-callback-tb-gaps) concluded with an evidence-backed negative: no new credible variant found in the surfaces audited. Evidence: (1) Dispatch cores verified to hand optional slots to per-kind callbacks — net/sched/sch_api.c:1237 ops->init(sch, tca[TCA_OPTIONS]) and :1321 ops->change(...) both pass an optional-in-policy TCA_OPTIONS attribute with no core-side NULL check, and net/sched/act_api.c:944 a_o->init(net, tb[TCA_ACT_OPTIONS], ...) likewise — so the invariant must be enforced by each callee. (2) Every callee actually read enforces it: qdisc init/change callbacks in sch_fifo.c:67-71, sch_plug.c:136-140/167-171, sch_cbs.c:355-369, sch_gred.c:631/655-670, sch_red.c:195-201, sch_atm.c:222-232, sch_dsmark.c:355-373, sch_etf.c:354-370, sch_choke.c:353-368, sch_netem.c:960-964, sch_htb.c:1008-1021, sch_prio.c:237-244/187-188, sch_mqprio.c:158-163, sch_multiq.c:244-248, sch_hfsc.c:1394/1433, sch_sfq.c:626-636/751-754, sch_cake.c:2532-2533/2681-2685, sch_taprio.c:1397-1442 (PRIOMAP use guarded, NULL-able mqprio handled by taprio_parse_mqprio_opt 'if (!qopt && !dev->num_tc)' and taprio_mqprio_cmp 'if (!mqprio || ...)'), sch_cbq.c:1127-1130/1173-1180/1564; action init callbacks act_bpf.c:290/299-302, act_ife.c:483/495-497, act_nat.c:48/58-59, act_police.c:58-59/78-82. (3) rtnl_link_ops kinds read function-by-function — net/hsr/hsr_netlink.c hsr_newlink (per-slave early-return guards at 44-56 before nla_get_u32 at 47/55) and drivers/net/gtp.c gtp_newlink (at-least-one FD0/FD1 idiom at 668-669 with every consumed slot individually guarded in gtp_encap_enable at 845/853/867 and PDP_HASHSIZE at 674) — are safe. Candidates already reported for s01 (mac802154_hwsim.c, nft_tunnel.c, net/mpls/af_mpls.c) were not re-reported. Limitations (recorded in the artifact): ~50 rtnl_link_ops kinds (vxlan, geneve, macsec, bonding, ipvlan, vrf, veth, team, tun, bridges/vlans, tunnels, xfrm_interface, rmnet, can, ipoib, batman-adv, etc.) were enumerated but not deep-read on s01; cls_*.c change callbacks and ~16 remaining action init callbacks were not read; nf_tables expression init callbacks beyond nft_tunnel were covered only by prior artifacts' forms; no compilation/reproducer was run (read-only tree).
